column3: Waist-up shot, facing the viewer, idol outfit. Both hands cupping her own cheeks, head tilted a little, happy open-mouth smile, eyes wide open with big white star highlights in the pupils. Landscape 3:2, figure centered and cropped at the waist.

Face close-up, framed from the top of the head to the chin, the face and hair fill the frame. Eyes gently closed, peaceful soft smile, light blush, bangs falling over the forehead, whale-fin ears at the sides. Landscape 3:2; any area not covered by hair or face is flat green.

Extreme close-up of ONE of her eyes with a bit of bangs, eyelashes and cheek, filling the whole frame like the second style reference. Huge blue iris with a large bright white six-pointed star highlight in the pupil and a few small light spots. Landscape 3:2.

Casual off-stage outfit: oversized pale lavender hoodie and a white baseball cap worn forward, whale-fin ears poking out at the sides of the cap, small whale pin on the cap. Waist-up shot: she raises her index finger to her lips in a 'shh, it's a secret' gesture and winks playfully with one eye. Landscape 3:2.

Full body, standing straight facing the viewer, hands clasped behind her back, calm small smile, idol outfit, whale tail visible beside her legs. Portrait 2:3, the whole figure with margin on all sides.

Full body idol stage performance pose, idol outfit: holding a handheld microphone near her mouth with her right hand, left arm stretched out to the side, singing joyfully with mouth open, one knee slightly bent, skirt, hair and whale tail swaying with the motion. Portrait 2:3, the whole figure with margin.

Thigh-up shot, idol outfit, leaning toward the camera, winking with one eye and pointing her index finger straight at the viewer (foreshortened hand close to the camera), big confident smile. Landscape 3:2.

Upper body in clean side profile facing RIGHT, idol outfit, one arm stretched straight forward pointing to the right with her index finger, calm serious expression, star highlight in the visible eye, hair flowing behind her. She stands in the left half of the frame and her fingertip reaches near the right edge. Landscape 3:2.

Full body seen from directly behind, idol outfit, standing still and looking slightly up into the distance, arms relaxed at her sides, long hair and whale tail visible. Portrait 2:3, the whole figure with margin.

Upper body seen from a slightly low angle, idol outfit, singing passionately with eyes half closed and mouth open, head tilted back, one arm raised high with an open hand reaching up, the other hand holding a microphone at her chest, hair lifted by motion. Neutral even lighting. Landscape 3:2.
Waist-up shot, idol outfit, her back half turned to the viewer as she looks back over her shoulder at the viewer with a warm gentle smile and slightly teary star eyes, hair swinging. Landscape 3:2.
